variants.description: Inverser le facteur de conversion Celsius vers Fahrenheit
Oublier le décalage de 32 degrés Fahrenheit
Mettre à jour la distance lorsque le chemin est plus long au lieu de plus court
variants.code:
import sys
import re

lignes = [l.strip() for l in sys.stdin.read().splitlines() if l.strip()]

for lig in lignes:
    m = re.search(r'nom=([^\s]+).*?DISTS=([^\s]+).*?ARC=([^\s]+)', lig)
    if not m:
        continue
    nom = m.group(1)
    dists_str = m.group(2)
    arc_str = m.group(3)

    dists = {}
    for item in dists_str.split(','):
        if not item.strip():
            continue
        s, d = item.split(':')
        dists[s.strip()] = float('inf') if d.strip() == 'inf' else int(d.strip())

    m_arc = re.match(r'([^-]+)->([^:]+):(-?\d+)', arc_str)
    if not m_arc:
        continue
    u = m_arc.group(1).strip()
    v = m_arc.group(2).strip()
    w = int(m_arc.group(3))

    dist_u = dists.get(u, float('inf'))
    dist_v_before = dists.get(v, float('inf'))

    amelioration = False
    dist_v_after = dist_v_before

    if dist_u != float('inf') and dist_u + w > dist_v_before:
        amelioration = True
        dist_v_after = dist_u + w

    dav_str = "inf" if dist_v_before == float('inf') else str(dist_v_before)
    dap_str = "inf" if dist_v_after == float('inf') else str(dist_v_after)
    stat = "OUI" if amelioration else "NON"

    print(f"RELAX: nom={nom} | ARC: {arc_str} | AMELIORATION: {stat} | DIST_AVANT: {dav_str} | DIST_APRES: {dap_str}")

variants.description: Oublier de vider la copie de travail après le stash

read -r n
copie=0
remises=()
for ((i=0; i<n; i++)); do
  read -r op
  if [ "$op" = "modifie" ]; then
    copie=$((copie + 1))
  elif [ "$op" = "stash" ]; then
    remises+=("$copie")
    copie=$copie
  elif [ "$op" = "pop" ]; then
    total=${#remises[@]}
    if [ "$total" = "0" ]; then
      echo "rien à reprendre"
    else
      dernier=$((total - 1))
      copie=$((copie + ${remises[$dernier]}))
      unset 'remises[dernier]'
      remises=("${remises[@]}")
    fi
  elif [ "$op" = "etat" ]; then
    echo "copie : $copie"
    echo "remises : ${#remises[@]}"
  fi
done

variants.code:
read -r n
noms=(main)
comptes=(0)
courante=0
for ((i=0; i<n; i++)); do
  read -r op nom
  if [ "$op" = "commit" ]; then
    comptes[$courante]=$(( ${comptes[$courante]} + 1 ))
  elif [ "$op" = "branch" ]; then
    noms+=("$nom")
    comptes+=(0)
  elif [ "$op" = "checkout" ]; then
    for idx in "${!noms[@]}"; do
      [ "${noms[$idx]}" = "$nom" ] && courante=$idx

    for idx in "${!noms[@]}"; do

  fi
done

pattern='^([a-z]+)(\(([^()]*)\))?(!)?: (.*)$'
while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
  [ -z "$line" ] && continue
  id=$(printf '%s' "$line" | sed -E 's/^COMMIT_MSG id=([^ ]+).*$/\1/')
  msg=$(printf '%s' "$line" | sed -E 's/^COMMIT_MSG id=[^ ]+ msg=//')
  if [[ ! "$msg" =~ $pattern ]]; then
    printf 'CONVENTIONAL_AUDIT id=%s valid=NON error=FORMAT_INVALIDE\n' "$id"
    continue
  fi
  type="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
  scope="${BASH_REMATCH[3]}"
  mark="${BASH_REMATCH[4]}"
  description="${BASH_REMATCH[5]}"
  case "$type" in feat|fix|docs|refactor|test|chore|perf|ci) ;; *) printf 'CONVENTIONAL_AUDIT id=%s valid=NON error=TYPE_INCONNU\n' "$id"; continue ;; esac
  if [ -z "$description" ]; then printf 'CONVENTIONAL_AUDIT id=%s valid=NON error=DESCRIPTION_VIDE\n' "$id"; continue; fi
  [ -z "$scope" ] && scope=NONE
  breaking=NON
  if [[ -n "$mark" || "$msg" == *'BREAKING CHANGE'* ]]; then breaking=OUI; fi
  printf 'CONVENTIONAL_AUDIT id=%s valid=OUI type=%s scope=%s breaking=%s\n' "$id" "$type" "$scope" "$breaking"
done
